text_simplified: The text discusses a Prophetic tarbiyah (upbringing) curriculum that considers the individual differences among children and employs diverse methods such as motivation and honoring to reinforce positive behavior. It explains how the Prophet ﷺ dealt with the Sahabah (his companions) in ways suited to their abilities and social status to achieve tarbiyah goals.
